gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Packed, confident titles: Oswald knits each row of display type tight. Noto Sans Tifinagh, a sans-serif, still reads a size down, with rounded letters and inflated bowls.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-impe: Bold marker titles with hollow curves: Red Hat Display looks contemporary. And Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic, a sans, still reads a size down, pincer-open c and a short cap step.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-insc: A constant-width marker line with daylight in every curve marks Red Hat Display. And Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian, a sans-serif, still reads a size down, with big open eyes on e and a.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Oswald knits confident, strong rows of display type tight. Noto Sans Warang Citi, a plain sans, walks running copy as solid blocks, with wide channels into each counter.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-jp: A very high x-height and sweep-open curves make the body read modern under Red Hat Display. Noto Sans JP, a plain sans, does the running line, while Red Hat Display does the daylight shout.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Tightly knit rows of text mark Oswald as strong, confident display. Noto Sans Zanabazar Square, a sans, still reads a size down, with wide gaps that stay crisp and a soaring x-height.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-kait: Noto Sans Kaithi, a sans-serif, opens the e and fills the line like capitals under Red Hat Display. And a stretch of copy still moves, marker-flat up top and cap-like below.
gen-boska-fs-epilogue: Unclamped, curvy letters on a wire-like monoline make Epilogue read approachable under Boska's carved stone stems. The snap is carved stems against that unclamped sans-serif skeleton.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Inviting marker-tip letters from Chubbo take a smooth path around each bend. Noto Traditional Nushu, a sans, walks running copy with a broad-nib stroke that never curls shut.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-numans: Oswald knits strong, confident rows of display type into a tight band. Numans, a plain sans, walks running copy with a far-flung s, coiled-rope small letters, and wide tracking.
gen-boska-archivo: Outward-opening curves and a commanding x-height make Archivo read editorial under Boska's carved stems and glass serifs. Carved serifs plus that sans-serif line share one sheet.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-onest: Approachable short ascenders over big bowls meet Oswald's packed, confident rows. Onest, a sans-serif, brings a gentle monotone, and the snap is packed titles against that unpooled wire.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-noto-sans-kaya: Clean brush-lifted curves sit under Red Hat Display's contrast-free marker stroke, with capitals barely taller than small letters. Noto Sans Kayah Li, a sans-serif, and that heading share one sheet.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-oxygen: Marker-tip letters with a clear path around every bend: Chubbo looks casual, inviting, and unswollen. Oxygen, a plain sans, walks running copy without closing its curves.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-pathway-extreme: Pathway Extreme, a plain sans, opens its rounded letters under Oswald's packed rows. Pathway Extreme still reads a size down, with stubby extenders and a big x-height.
